subject: Brightline Insurance — security evidence request (SOC 2, audit logs, encryption, retention)
body:
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Megan Liu <megan.liu@brightlineinsurance.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, May 15, 2025 at 9:14 AM PT
Subject: Brightline Insurance — security evidence request (SOC 2, audit logs, encryption, retention)

Hi Megan,

Thanks again for the security review earlier this week.

To make sure we turn this around quickly, can you send the specific evidence items you need (or your standard vendor evidence checklist) and the deadline your team is working toward?

We can provide a packaged set of security artifacts under NDA, plus additional detail for audit logging / retention depending on whether you’re evaluating Dedicated vs Private (VPC).

Best,
Avery Johnson
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Megan Liu <megan.liu@brightlineinsurance.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@brightlineinsurance.com>
Date: Thu, May 15, 2025 at 9:41 AM PT
Subject: Re: Brightline Insurance — security evidence request (SOC 2, audit logs, encryption, retention)

Hi Avery (Naomi/Olga),

Attached is our evidence checklist. For scheduling, we’re aiming to complete the initial review by EOD Wed 5/21 so we can keep procurement on track.

Highest priority items for our review:
- SOC 2 Type II report (and scope statement)
- Any security overview / whitepaper that includes encryption at rest/in transit
- Description of audit logs (fields + export options) and retention controls
- SSO/SAML details + RBAC
- Incident response summary + breach notification timelines
- Data handling: whether prompts/outputs are stored, and if so for how long

If you have anything that is “under NDA only,” we can route it via our vendor portal.

Thanks,
Megan Liu
Vendor Risk Manager | Brightline Insurance

Attachment: Brightline_Vendor_Security_Evidence_Request.xlsx


---

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Megan Liu <megan.liu@brightlineinsurance.com>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@brightlineinsurance.com>
Date: Thu, May 15, 2025 at 10:18 AM PT
Subject: Re: Brightline Insurance — security evidence request (SOC 2, audit logs, encryption, retention)

Hi Megan,

Got it — thank you for the checklist and the 5/21 target.

We can turn around a “core evidence pack” quickly, and then follow with a short addendum specific to audit logs + retention based on the deployment model you’re considering (Dedicated vs Private/VPC).

What we can provide (typical):
1) SOC 2 Type II report + scope statement (NDA required; we share via a restricted link only)
2) Security overview: encryption in transit (TLS), encryption at rest, and key management options (including KMS/HSM integrations for Private deployments)
3) Audit logging: a redacted sample event set + field list, plus export patterns (format + destination options)
4) Access controls: SSO/SAML overview, RBAC model, admin audit events
5) Data handling + retention: how request/response data is handled by default and what retention controls are available
6) Incident response overview + security contact / escalation process

Redaction / restricted sharing guidance (so expectations are clear):
- We will redact customer identifiers, internal hostnames/IPs, and any environment-specific details in screenshots/log examples.
- We watermark and restrict access to the SOC 2 report; please do not forward externally. If your vendor portal requires upload, we can provide a time-bound link instead (preferred), or upload a redacted copy if needed.

Two quick questions so we package this correctly:
- Are you primarily evaluating Redwood Dedicated or Redwood Private (VPC)?
- Who should be the approved recipients on your side (names/emails)?

If you confirm the above today, we can target:
- By Fri 5/16: evidence pack index + encryption overview + sample audit log events (redacted)
- By Mon 5/19: SOC 2 report shared via restricted link (pending NDA confirmation)

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Security & Compliance Product Alignment | Redwood Inference
security@redwoodinference.com

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Daniel Carter <daniel.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, May 15, 2025 at 10:27 AM PT
Subject: Re: Brightline Insurance — security evidence request (SOC 2, audit logs, encryption, retention)

Naomi —

A few notes from GRC side (for Brightline):

- SOC 2 Type II: NDA required, and we should only share via SecureShare (restricted recipients + expiration). No direct email attachment.
- If they insist on vendor portal upload, we need confirmation of portal access controls + who has access. Ideally provide link instead.
- For incident response: stick to the approved summary language (no numeric SLA claims unless in contract).

Daniel has the latest redacted audit log sample event set ready; I’ll have him attach the current version.

Olga Petrov
GRC & Security Questionnaires | Redwood Inference

From: Daniel Carter <daniel.carter@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Brightline Insurance — security evidence request (SOC 2, audit logs, encryption, retention)

Sharing the updated redacted artifacts we’ve been using for the ABM pilot:

- Redwood_Regulated_Workloads_Evidence_Pack_Index.pdf
- Redwood_Audit_Log_Sample_Events_redacted.json
- Redwood_Encryption_and_Key_Management_Overview.pdf

Notes:
- Audit log samples show: auth events, config change events, model route changes, and request metadata events. All customer identifiers removed.
- The “export destinations” section is written to be accurate for Private/VPC (customer-controlled log pipeline) and doesn’t over-promise for Hosted.

Daniel Carter
Compliance Support | Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- Redwood_Regulated_Workloads_Evidence_Pack_Index.pdf
- Redwood_Audit_Log_Sample_Events_redacted.json
- Redwood_Encryption_and_Key_Management_Overview.pdf

+1 to Olga’s note: do not email the SOC 2 as an attachment.

Also, for anything “HIPAA-ready” / “compliant” language (they sometimes ask in insurance contexts), please keep it to: “We support private/VPC deployments and enterprise security controls used by regulated customers; we’ll align on your requirements during the security review.”

Naomi — OK to send Daniel’s three artifacts now as they’re already redacted and generic.

Aisha
Dr. Aisha Rahman
CISO | Redwood Inference

Hi Megan,

Following up with the first tranche of redacted materials so your team can start review:
- Evidence pack index (what’s available + how to request)
- Encryption + key management overview
- Redacted audit log sample events (illustrative fields + examples)

Next step for SOC 2 Type II report:
- We can share it via a restricted, expiring link once we confirm NDA is in place and the approved recipient list on your side.
- If you prefer your vendor portal, please confirm who has access to uploads and whether downloads are restricted/audited. Our preference is a time-bound link to named recipients.

Two questions to ensure we send the right addendum:
1) Are you evaluating Dedicated or Private (VPC) as the likely deployment path?
2) Can you confirm the approved recipients (names/emails) for restricted sharing?

If you reply today/tomorrow AM, we should still be on track for the 5/21 initial review date.

Regards,
Naomi Feldman
Security & Compliance Product Alignment | Redwood Inference
